notes.title: update
notes.content: [p]Hello, players![/p][p]I'd like to thank everyone who's been contributing to the development of the game—whether through reviews, ideas, or pointing out bugs. All the feedback I've received has been incredibly helpful![/p][p][b]What’s new?[/b][/p][list][*][p]The character control mechanics have been changed. Now, instead of the character automatically turning and shooting, the player controls the direction by aiming with the mouse. Shots are fired by clicking or holding the left mouse button.[/p][/*][*][p]New characters have been added to help players achieve higher scores.[/p][/*][*][p]Several small bugs have been fixed.[/p][/*][*][p]The button that previously made the character turn has been replaced with an option to purchase a boomerang that hits nearby enemies on both the left and right sides of the character.[/p][/*][*][p]A volume control bar has been added in the upper corner of the screen.[/p][/*][*][p]The game has been rebalanced to improve gameplay—making easy moments a bit more challenging and tough enemies slightly more manageable.[/p][/*][/list][p]I hope you enjoy these improvements, and I'm looking forward to hearing what else you'd like to see in the game![/p]

notes.title: Update
notes.content: [list][*][p]Added a slider to adjust the background music volume.[/p][/*][*][p]Keyboard controls have been implemented.[/p][/*][*][p]Floating character movements have been smoothed for a better visual experience.[/p][/*][*][p]new character has been added: it hovers above the player and periodically eliminates the enemy with the highest health.[/p][/*][*][p]Added an auto-direction switch feature (left/right), allowing players to focus solely on upgrades.[/p][/*][*][p]A global ranking leaderboard has been added (currently in testing).[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: update.
notes.content:
It was possible to purchase additional upgrades even after reaching the maximum level, which caused some items to stop functioning correctly.

Fixed.
